description: Update the comment and/or tags of an existing entry (running, paused, or stopped) without changing its tracked time. Use this instead of logging a new entry when the user wants to annotate, describe, or re-tag something already tracked. Get activity_id from get_current_status (active timers) or list_intervals (past entries).

activity_id.description: Activity id from get_current_status or list_intervals (internal — never show ids to the user)

comment.description: New comment — replaces the existing one; "" clears it

tags.description: Full new tag list — replaces existing tags (include current tags to keep them); [] clears them

name: update_activity
